title: White bands in St. Louis: Trumbauer, Beiderbecke and the Arcadia
summary: Asked about white musicians, he only heard some of their tunes and knew of the Arcadia Ballroom.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Did you know Frank Trombquer? Did you know any of the white musicians in St. Louis?
No. No, I don't know -- I got a chance to hear some of his -- Frank Trombquer's and some of Bix Beider-becke's tunes that they were doing -- things like that.
Uh-huh. They worked at the Arcadia Ballroom there.
Arcadia Ballroom, yeah. That's right, I heard about that.
I ran into a man who did some of the arranging for that band, Bud Hassler.
Well, go ahead with your story.
